title: Gadget Racers
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 6875 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Racing. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
A accelerate, B brake
R use item / boost
Cars are small toy racers (Choro-Q style)
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text:
Body, engine, tyres, brakes and wings are swapped individually.
Each part changes speed, acceleration or grip.
widgets.label: Parts

widgets.text:
Toy cars are light: avoid side hits in corners.
Upgrade tyres early, the first tracks are twisty.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Grand Prix cups made of several tracks; finishing high earns money and parts.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text:
Prize money buys parts in the shop.
Better engines unlock the faster cups.
widgets.label: Shop

widgets.text: Collect bodies and parts from wins and the shop.
widgets.label: Collection

widgets.text: Win each cup class to open the next.
widgets.label: Goal
